🏛️ Parliament has gone home for nearly four weeks.

The Commons rose on 16 September. The Lords rise today. Neither returns until 11 October.

And on 1 October — right in the middle of that gap — your energy bill goes up 4% to £1,723. 💡 The single most-felt policy event of the autumn, with nobody in the chamber to answer for it.

Then MPs get barely a fortnight back before a Budget on 28 October that the PM won't rule out tax rises in. 📋

To be fair: recess isn't a scandal. Conference season is real, and MPs in their constituencies are doing proper work — I know, I do it. But scrutiny that arrives after the decision isn't scrutiny. It's commentary.

Read my honest take 👇
